title: 1955 AHSME Problem 44
statement: In circle \(O\) chord \(\overline{AB}\) is produced so that \(\overline{BC}\) equals a radius of the circle. \(\overline{CO}\) is drawn and extended to \(D.\) \(\overline{AO}\) is drawn. Which of the following expresses the relationship between angles \(x\) and \(y?\)

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: there is no special relationship between \(x\) and \(y\)

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
\(x=2y\) or \(x=3y,\) depending upon the length of
\(\overline{AB}\)

solutions.text:
Because \(OB=BC,\) triangle \(OBC\) is isosceles, so \(\angle BOC=\angle BCO=y.\) Its exterior angle at \(B\) is therefore \(\angle ABO=2y.\) Since \(OA=OB,\) triangle \(AOB\) is also isosceles and \(\angle OAB=2y.\) In triangle \(AOC,\) the angles at \(A\) and \(C\) are \(2y\) and \(y,\) so \(\angle AOC=180^\circ-3y.\) Angle \(x=\angle AOD\) is supplementary to \(\angle AOC,\) hence \(x=3y.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Use the exterior angle at \(B\), then use \(OA=OB\)
